target.title: fix(trajectory): session.ended timestamp matches model.completed before cleanup
target.body:
Closes #102014

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where trajectory exports showed `session.ended` with the same timestamp as `model.completed`, so cleanup duration looked like zero even when teardown took real wall-clock time.

## Why This Change Was Made

`session.ended` was recorded in `finalizeEmbeddedAttempt` immediately after `model.completed`, then marked complete so the cleanup phase skipped it. This PR defers `session.ended` until after resource cleanup, keeps the finalize terminal status/error, and flushes trajectory events before and after cleanup so earlier events stay durable if teardown hangs. No new event types or exporter knobs.

## User Impact

Operators reading trajectory traces can measure real session end time versus model compute time, including cleanup latency.

## Evidence

Verified at HEAD `d371ea1f01` (post rebase). Source ordering before the fix: finalize emits `model.completed` then `session.ended`, then `trajectoryEndRecorded = true`, so cleanup never re-emitted.

Focused tests:

```
pnpm test src/trajectory/runtime.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-session-cleanup.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-execution-settle.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-trajectory-status.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-trajectory-flush-cleanup.test.ts

Test Files  5 passed (5)
     Tests  37 passed (37)
```

CI follow-up (`6c4e13c66b`): un-exported unused `AttemptTrajectoryTerminalStatus` so `check-dependencies` Knip no longer flags it. Re-ran focused trajectory tests: 4 files / 38 tests passed.

Ordering coverage in `attempt-session-cleanup.test.ts`:

```
expect(order).toEqual([flush, cleanup, session.ended, flush]);
```

Timestamp mechanism coverage in `runtime.test.ts` (fake timers, 500ms delay between `model.completed` and `session.ended`):

```
expect(Date.parse(sessionEndedTs)).toBeGreaterThan(Date.parse(modelCompletedTs));
```

Real redacted trajectory export still pending: this machine does not have a live embedded-run setup that can produce a durable after-cleanup `session.ended` artifact. Unit/fake-timer proof remains above.

Data-model note: no persisted schema or event-shape migration. `session.ended` payload fields are unchanged; only emit timing moves from finalize into post-cleanup. The `runtime.test.ts` addition is fake-timer ordering coverage, not a serialized-state format change.

Local checks: `oxfmt --check` clean on touched files; `git diff --check` clean. `pnpm check:changed` could not run here (crabbox/blacksmith testbox binary unavailable on this machine).

## AI-assisted

Yes. Authored with Cursor/Grok assistance. Human: Stan Shih (stantheman0128).
